original.target_description: Experiment 4, University of Waterloo participant pool, lexical decisions with pseudohomophone foils; within-participant stimulus quality (clear/degraded) by word frequency (high/low). Multiple dependent measures on the supplied page prevent unique target-test identification.

n.sample_role: Participants in Experiment 4; participant-level analyses, including ex-Gaussian interaction tests with denominator df 31. Item analyses use a different sampling unit and are not represented by this n.
n.exclusions: No participant exclusions reported. All experiments excluded errors and RTs faster than 200 ms or slower than 3,000 ms, followed by latencies beyond 2.5 within-participant SDs. Experiment 4: overall error rate 11.4%; trimming removed an additional 3.5% of trials.
n.location: Printed p. 498 (PDF p. 4), Table 1, Experiment 4 row; printed p. 499, Results screening procedure; printed p. 503 (PDF p. 9), Experiment 4 Results and Ex-Gaussian analyses.

es.location: Printed p. 503 (PDF p. 9), Experiment 4 Results: Mean response latencies and accuracy; Variance and third cumulant; Ex-Gaussian analyses.

p.location: Printed p. 503 (PDF p. 9), Experiment 4 Results: Mean response latencies and accuracy; Variance and third cumulant; Ex-Gaussian analyses.

notes: Published article; title, authors, year and DOI match the supplied original reference. Study 4 and PDF p. 9 (printed p. 503) are located, but the supplied description does not identify the dependent measure. That page reports distinct stimulus-quality by word-frequency interactions for mean response latency, accuracy, variance, third cumulant, and ex-Gaussian mu, sigma and tau. Thus study and sample match, but unique outcome/test matching cannot be established. No effect size or p selected from competing tests. For disambiguation only: the mu interaction is printed F(1, 31) = 5.17, p = .030, eta-squared = .14; sigma interaction F(1, 31) = 2.96, p = .096, eta-squared = .09; tau interaction F(1, 31) = 2.52, p = .123, without printed eta-squared. Mean-latency interaction is Fp and Fi < 1 without a printed eta-squared or p; accuracy interaction has participant p = .053 and item p = .124 without a printed eta-squared. These are alternative outcomes, not interchangeable estimates. No conversions performed. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
